issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

evidence.quote: the goal of the AI RMF is to offer a voluntary resource to the organizations designing, developing, deploying, or using AI systems to help manage the many risks of AI
The Framework is intended to be voluntary, rights-preserving, non-sector specific, and use-case agnostic

implementation_notes: Crosswalks to the AI RMF 1.0 are voluntary resources. The framework is non-sector specific and use-case agnostic. NIST solicits ongoing public comments at AIframework@nist.gov. Alignment with international standards is cited as a top priority in the NIST Roadmap for the AI RMF.
